description: [Merchant] Validate and debug a payware JWT: decode header and payload, check the claims against the API's rules (algorithm, audience including the ISV on-behalf form, 5-minute freshness), and verify the contentSha256 hash against the request body when one is given

expectedPayload.description: The request body the token was made for (optional). Give it for POST, PUT and PATCH: contentSha256 is then required and checked against it. Leave it out for GET and DELETE, which carry no hash.

jwtToken.description: JWT token to validate and debug

name: payware_authentication_validate_jwt
